propositions: Container close with N children triggers O(5N) full-store scans via per-child compute_validity calls to completion-verifier branch, which recomputes current_material_fingerprint plus legacy retries and stale-material explanation
Wrapping the per-child validity loop with material_child_index snapshot reduces full-store scan count from O(5N) to constant (one wide scan per close), with scan count independent of child count
Child verdict correctness is preserved: children attesting true current fingerprints remain certified, stale children remain uncertified, and unclosed children continue to block

Performance regression originated in commit 66f0220d747 (epic dark-acme-lumen) which introduced both the per-child compute_validity loop and the completion-branch fingerprint recompute, not as a later regression of working behavior
